name: Send new BookMyShow movie or event alerts to Telegram with Apify
description:
## Quick Overview
This workflow runs every 6 hours, uses Apify’s BookMyShow Scraper to fetch the latest movie listings for a chosen city, deduplicates results across runs, and sends a Telegram message for each newly detected listing with key details and a booking link.

## How it works
1. Runs on a schedule every 6 hours.
2. Sets the target BookMyShow city and scrape mode (movies).
3. Calls the Apify BookMyShow Scraper actor to pull up to 30 current listings with details.
4. Filters out any listings whose BookMyShow eventCode has already been seen in previous workflow executions.
5. Sends a Telegram message for each new listing with the title, language, certification, rating, release date, and URL.

## Setup
1. Install and configure the Apify node, then add an Apify API token credential.
2. Create a Telegram bot, add a Telegram API credential in n8n, and set the Telegram chat ID to receive messages.
3. Update the city (for example, mumbai) and optionally change scrapeMode to events if you want event alerts instead of movies.
4. Adjust the schedule interval if you want the workflow to check BookMyShow more or less frequently.

workflow.name: Get a Telegram alert when a new movie hits BookMyShow in your city

parameters.content:
## 🎬 Get a Telegram alert when a new movie or event hits BookMyShow in your city

Runs on a schedule, checks BookMyShow for what's currently listed in your city, and pings you on Telegram the moment something new shows up. Powered by the **BookMyShow Scraper** Apify actor.

### 💡 What you can do with it
- Get first-look alerts the moment a movie you're waiting for opens for booking
- Track new concerts and live events landing in your city
- Feed a running log of releases into your own dashboard instead of checking BookMyShow by hand

### 🚀 Setup (2 minutes)
1. Install the **Apify** node: nodes panel → search "Apify" → **Install**
2. Add your free Apify token as an **Apify API** credential — grab one at [console.apify.com/account/integrations](https://console.apify.com/account/integrations)
3. Add a **Telegram API** credential (create a bot via @BotFather, then message it once and use @get_id_bot to find your chat ID)
4. Set `city` to any BookMyShow city (`mumbai`, `delhi-ncr`, `bengaluru`, ...) and `scrapeMode` to `movies` or `events`
5. Click **Test workflow**

### ✅ Good to know
- New Apify accounts include free usage, so you can try this at no cost
- The first run alerts on everything currently listed (nothing to compare against yet) — real "new since last check" alerts start from the second run onward
- No BookMyShow login needed; the actor uses Indian residential proxy by default since BookMyShow blocks non-Indian traffic

**Actor:** https://apify.com/getascraper/bookmyshow-scraper

## ⏰ Run on a schedule

Checks every 6 hours by default. Adjust the interval to fit how fresh you need the alerts.

## 🏙️ Pick your city

Set `city` (e.g. `mumbai`, `delhi-ncr`, `bengaluru`) and `scrapeMode` (`movies` or `events`). Prefilled with a verified-live sample.

## 🎟️ Pull current listings

Fetches every movie or event currently live in that city, with cast, rating, and release date.

Pay per result. New Apify accounts get free usage to start.

## 🆕 Keep only what's new

Remembers every `eventCode` seen on past runs and only lets brand-new listings through — no repeat alerts for the same movie.

## 📩 Send the alert

One Telegram message per new movie or event, with language, certification, rating, and a direct booking link.
